review:
About as simple as modern slots get: three reels, five paylines, dice-style fruit and no bonus round. The joker is the top-paying symbol and pays when three line up.

The max win is only 40x, one of the lowest on the site, with low-medium volatility and a 96.41% RTP. It's a calm, low-stakes game for long sessions, not for chasing big hits. If that sounds good, check our low max win list for more like it.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
